summary: preact/compat flushSync now batches the state updates made inside its callback into one synchronous render instead of rendering once per setter
Supported browsers raised to Chrome 71 / Safari 12.1 / Firefox 69 / Edge 79 without polyfills; IE11 support dropped
Minimum supported TypeScript version raised to 5.1

Core and add-on bundles ship only as .mjs ES modules; the .module.js, CommonJS, UMD and .min builds are removed (require('preact') works only via require(esm)), and exports.browser became exports.module
The exports maps in the nested package.json files of subpackages (hooks, compat, debug, jsx-runtime, ...) are removed; resolution goes through the root package.json exports
ref passed to a component is now forwarded as an ordinary prop (ref on a function component reaches its props) instead of pointing at the component instance; forwardRef is no longer needed
Hook dependency arrays and useState/useReducer bail-outs compare with Object.is instead of ===, so NaN is treated as unchanged (and +0/-0 as different)
Core no longer appends px to numeric style values (style={{height: 500}} renders height:500); the automatic px suffix only applies with preact/compat
defaultProps on components is only applied when preact/compat is loaded; core Preact ignores it
The optional third replaceNode parameter of render() is removed (use preact-root-fragment's createRootFragment instead)
Component.base (the component's root DOM node) is removed from class component instances
SuspenseList is removed from preact/compat
useEffect cleanups of an unmounting component now run after paint (deferred like React) instead of synchronously during unmount
useRef's type now requires an initial value, and RefObject<T> describes current as exactly T (include null in T where needed)

The JSX namespace keeps only the types TypeScript needs (Element, IntrinsicElements, ...); DOM attribute types such as JSX.ButtonHTMLAttributes move to the preact namespace (import { ButtonHTMLAttributes } from 'preact')
The deprecated ForwardFn type is removed from preact/compat
JSX types restrict the role attribute of , , , and

Event handler props whose name has an uppercase letter after 'on' (onMyEvent) always listen for the lowercased event (myevent); Preact 10 kept the original casing for events the DOM element didn't know
Re-rendering the same (hoisted, constant) vnode object no longer skips diffing that subtree; it is diffed like any other vnode
The check for whether a DOM sibling is still mounted uses parentNode presence instead of contains(); listed under breaking changes, effect on application code unclear
The optional peer dependency preact-render-to-string is raised from >=5 to >=6.7.0
Hydration 2.0: suspended boundaries are hydrated against comment markers emitted by the server renderer, allowing 0 or 2+ DOM nodes per async boundary instead of exactly one
When reordering children Preact uses Element.moveBefore() where the browser supports it instead of insertBefore(), preserving state such as focus and iframe content of moved nodes
When an already-revealed Suspense boundary suspends again, its components keep their committed hook state (effects are cleaned up and re-run on reveal) instead of resetting it
preact/compat reports React version 19.0.0 (its exported version) instead of the 18.x it reported before
The list of unitless CSS properties that don't get an automatic px suffix (now a preact/compat feature) was made more accurate, changing which numeric style values get px
